configuration.description: Active nodes fail stochastically; affected workloads can be requeued and retried.
configuration.horizon_rationale: Fixed 90-minute fault-injection window spans the 80-minute maximum nominal deadline and permits repeated three-step recovery cycles; stochastic failures may still leave valid work unresolved.
configuration.intended_stress: Failure handling, recovery, and requeue behaviour.
configuration.name: Node failure and recovery
configuration.seed_behavior: Workload profile and topology are fixed by suite version; arrival jitter and failure traces are deterministic for the supplied seed.

limitations: Synthetic one-minute simulation; power and energy are not facility telemetry.
Results are scenario- and seed-specific; small samples are not statistically conclusive.
Every policy runs the same declared fixed horizon; unresolved workload outcomes are reported separately from execution status.
Offline Nemotron policy records fallback execution, not model inference.
Model-generated explanations are rationales, not causal proof.
